gap.description: Idle between targets so shared dependencies settle.

Duration.description: A duration such as "30s", "10m" or "1h30m". Units are required.

attributes.description:
Free-form attributes carried from the resolved inventory — instance type, AZ,
image digest, task definition revision. Opaque to the engine; echoed into the
output so comparison can explain an outlier.

host_header.description:
Sent as `Host`, and used for TLS SNI and certificate verification when going
direct to a container by IP. Most services route or vhost on it; a raw IP gets
a 404 or a default backend.

http_version.description: Protocol selection: auto uses ALPN for TLS and HTTP/1.1 for cleartext.

id.description: Stable identity for charts and comparison — a task id, instance id, or hostname.

oneOf.description:
Decouples results from sweep position: the first target pays cold-cache costs
on shared dependencies that the rest do not.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Raises a run annotation when used.

sni.description: Overrides `host_header` for SNI when they must differ.
